description: This bar chart illustrates the relationship between the number of shots and a value denoted as gamma (γ). The horizontal axis represents “Number of Shots” with categories labeled 0, 1, 2, 3, and 4, displayed in ascending order. The vertical axis is labeled “γB” and represents a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.6, with tick marks at 0.2 intervals. Each category has a single bar colored in a shade of purple with diagonal stripes. The bar corresponding to 0 shots has an approximate height of 0.52, while the bar for 4 shots reaches approximately 0.32. The heights of the bars generally decrease as the number of shots increases, with the tallest bar at 0 shots and the shortest at 4 shots. No bars are visually emphasized with different shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
